{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] '''whistleblower''' wanted help avoiding his former employer's thugs, and hired a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] to access Czerka's databanks and erase all information about him. The slicer erased all of the whistleblower's aliases, contacts, accounts and known locations, leaving no trail for Czerka to follow. The grateful whistleblower was happy to pay for this service.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Off the Grid}}</ref>
